junit.count_semantics: Counts are per XML. The observed skipped field includes xfail; skipped_non_xfail excludes xfail. Subset XML files overlap fast.xml and must not be added as unique tests. Every skipped/xfail name is retained below.

fixture_setup_failure.cause: The temporary instrumented source used absolute quoted includes that pointed to a checkout on a different Windows volume; os.path.relpath could not represent those paths relative to the temporary source directory.
fixture_setup_failure.audit_issue_records_explanation: Each of the same 28 setup errors produces one recorded_test_error and one target_not_passed audit issue. The XML contains 28 affected testcase identities, not 56 independent test failures.

macos_memory_probe.interpretation: RSS and tree RSS were observed. Private tree memory was unavailable; the separate USS diagnostic was not queried in this run.

limitations: JUnit proves recorded testcase status. The 28 Windows instrumented test bodies did not run because their common fixture failed before the primary probe compilation.
No instrumented probe binary payload or probe binary hash is archived or claimed.
Production binary hashes are aligned across build and benchmark metadata. Binary payloads are absent, so their bytes cannot be independently rehashed from these artifacts.
Pair maxima and byte comparisons are reported by the source-bound CI harnesses; raw spectra are not archived. Direct smoke equality is independently checked from stored hashes.
Native JUnit subsets overlap the full suite. Counts across XML files are not distinct-test totals.
The numerical measurements describe these CI runners and this source revision; they do not establish a speedup on a physical user device.

previous_validation_preserved.scope: The ca2d26/5f64570 validation remains a separate immutable cohort; none of its measurements are relabelled as this source.

limitations: CI validation is distinct from physical user-device reports; these results do not claim that the final runtime was rerun on those devices.
